title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2024
part_text: 98. Criticises the interventionist approach taken in EU foreign policy, in particular with regard to CSDP operations and missions; stresses that this is based on a neocolonial geopolitical approach, abusing neighbouring countries and regions as gatekeepers for the EU’s security interests and as raw materials suppliers; calls for the complete reconsideration and even abolishment of EU military training and advisory missions, also in view of the disastrous results and effects these have had in the past in Afghanistan, Mali and Niger; rejects the Rapid Deployment Capacity, which is de facto a revision of the EU Battlegroups concept, with a minimum of 5 000 troops for deployment outside the EU in non-permissive environments;
